These similarities are either routine formulae or broad civic themes; none reproduces the child's distinctive machinery concerning mandatory census responses, confidentiality, restricted use of individual information, and penalties for disclosure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"do hereby declare and make known that under the aforesaid acts of Congress","parent_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim and make known that the annual quotas","explanation":"C22 uses a similar declaratory formula, but this is conventional proclamation language and does not establish a material template."},{"child_excerpt":"The sole purpose of the Census is to secure general statistical information","parent_excerpt":"The immigration quotas proclaimed above are designed solely for the purpose of compliance with the pertinent provisions of the said Immigration Act of 1924 and are not to be regarded as having any significance extraneous to such purpose.","explanation":"C22 contains a somewhat parallel purpose-limiting clarification, but its legal function and surrounding administrative machinery differ substantially from the child's detailed confidentiality assurances."},{"child_excerpt":"The prompt, complete, and accurate answering of all official inquiries made by Census officials should be regarded as one of the requirements of good citizenship and an exercise in fundamental democracy.","parent_excerpt":"each citizen, naturalized or native-born, reaffirm his faith in the basic principles that mold our way of life by forthrightly assuming and carrying out the obligations of citizenship","explanation":"C13 shares civic-duty and democracy rhetoric, but this is thematic rather than a distinctive operative drafting sequence."}]}
